propositions: Close transition should deterministically reject tickets with unchecked '- [ ]' AC checkboxes before invoking the LLM verifier, unless the item is tagged [operator-attested].
The precheck must reuse the shared regex matcher from det_operator_attested._OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE to ensure the [operator-attested] tag matching logic does not drift between surfaces.
Tickets with prose-only AC (no checkboxes) and non-completion close classes (duplicate/not_a_bug/escalated) should bypass the precheck unchanged.
The precheck should emit a teaching message guiding the operator to check the box after satisfying the criterion or edit the AC with justification.
Case-insensitive matching of the [operator-attested] tag exemption must allow unchecked items bearing this marker to pass the precheck.
